applies_why: The judge text treats Matthew 1:16 as a verse pressed on a link and notes that both sides answered it rather than counting it as an unanswered witness.
quote: the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge identifies the verse as answered and underdetermined rather than counting it as an unanswered witness, it obeys K-G4.
